incident.title: Reports page waits and then shows a gateway timeout
incident.description: The reports page spins for about a minute and then fails. Other pages load quickly. We noticed this at 10:00 UTC and do not know of any recent change. The report may contain more records than usual.

context.reported_change: No recent change reported; larger report size is a customer suspicion.
context.reported_impact: Report requests time out; other pages reportedly remain available.
